title: Pixels are numbers
predict: Predict: what happens when one pixel gets brighter?
instruction: Click a square to change its intensity. Adjust contrast.
label: contrast
note: Pixel values are data, not object labels.

title: A neuron makes a decision
predict: Predict: which input pushes the neuron above its threshold?
instruction: Move the weight. The sum and activation are computed live.
label: weight
note: One toy neuron; not a trained digit classifier.

title: Feature detectors
predict: Predict: will a vertical detector respond to a horizontal line?
instruction: Rotate the edge and compare filter responses.
label: edge angle
note: Analytic orientation response illustrates a feature detector.

title: Slide a convolution kernel
predict: Predict the output before moving the window.
instruction: Choose a kernel. Move the window through a fixed image.
label: window position
note: Valid cross-correlation, as used by CNN layers; no kernel flip.

title: Stride and output size
predict: Predict: does a larger stride preserve more detail?
instruction: Change the stride; inspect every sampled window.
label: stride
note: An 8×8 input and 3×3 kernel, no padding.

title: ReLU changes the signal
predict: Predict: what happens to negative activations?
instruction: Change the input shift and compare before/after.
label: input shift
note: ReLU(x)=max(0,x), with no learned parameters.

title: Max pooling
predict: Predict which value survives in each region.
instruction: Change pool size and compare the output grid.
label: pool size
note: Non-overlapping pooling; incomplete border windows omitted.

title: A growing receptive field
predict: Predict: how many pixels can one output see?
instruction: Add convolution layers. Each 3×3 layer expands the field.
label: layers
note: Stride 1, no dilation: receptive field = 1 + 2L.

title: Images become tokens
predict: Predict: how many tokens does this image produce?
instruction: Change patch size; see the sequence on the right.
label: patch size
note: 16×16 image; incomplete patches are omitted in this toy.

title: Attention across patches
predict: Predict: can one patch attend to a distant patch?
instruction: Click a query patch, then change softmax temperature.
label: temperature
note: Hand-authored 2D patch vectors; not attention from a trained ViT.

title: Boxes and intersection-over-union
predict: Predict: when is overlap zero or one?
instruction: Slide the predicted box and inspect IoU.
label: horizontal shift
note: IoU measures overlap, not class correctness.

title: Remove duplicate detections
predict: Predict: will a higher threshold keep more boxes?
instruction: Change the IoU threshold for greedy NMS.
label: IoU threshold
note: Fixed example predictions; real IoU-based suppression.

title: A prompt selects a region
predict: Predict: what changes when the seed moves?
instruction: Click the image and change color tolerance.
label: tolerance
note: Flood fill illustrates prompting; this is NOT SAM inference.

title: Image and text share a space
predict: Predict: which text vector is closest to the image?
instruction: Rotate the image vector. Compare cosine similarities.
label: image angle
note: Illustrative 2D vectors, not actual CLIP embeddings.

title: Contrastive learning
predict: Predict: what should happen to the diagonal?
instruction: Increase alignment and inspect the row probabilities and loss.
label: alignment
note: Synthetic logits illustrate InfoNCE; no model is being trained.

title: Zero-shot labels compete
predict: Predict: can confidence change when labels change?
instruction: Choose a label set and change softmax temperature.
label: temperature
note: Toy similarities; normalized scores are not calibrated probabilities.

title: The forward diffusion process
predict: Predict: what remains after adding lots of noise?
instruction: Change alpha-bar; the noise sample stays fixed until reseeded.
label: signal retained
note: x_t = sqrt(alpha-bar)x_0 + sqrt(1-alpha-bar)epsilon.

title: Predict noise, recover signal
predict: Predict: what happens if the noise estimate is wrong?
instruction: Change prediction error; compare the recovered image.
label: noise error
note: Known synthetic noise gives an oracle baseline, NOT trained diffusion.

title: Guidance changes direction
predict: Predict: where does strong guidance move the update?
instruction: Change guidance scale and inspect the vector arithmetic.
label: guidance scale
note: Toy 2D noise estimates: e_u + s(e_c − e_u).

title: A latent space of shapes
predict: Predict: is a halfway code a halfway shape?
instruction: Change the latent coordinate; compare compression and decoding.
label: latent coordinate
note: Analytic shape decoder, not a VAE trained on images.
